Timeline shorthand

            
Team member: Mewtwo / Confusion / Psystrike / L50 / 15-15-15.
              Separate team members with a semicolon. Generated team lists also work.

            

              
t9p1:db
At 9s, p1 uses move code db.

              
+1.5p1,2:db
1.5s later, p1 and p2 use db.

              
+0p3:s2
At the same time, p3 switches to slot 2.

              
+0b:c
The boss starts its configured charged move.

              
+0p1:d
p1 dodges the announced charged move.

              
t30p1:q
p1 voluntarily quits to the lobby.

              
+4p1:r
p1 rejoins with the same team.

            

            

              Times are written in seconds but must land on a whole or half
              second. r2 is not supported because party presets do
              not exist yet.
